title: cohesionClusters transitive-field clustering is too coarse — a connector field merges concerns into a megablob
wanted_capability: Connector-aware cohesion clustering. The v1 extract_java_class_cohesive_clusters partitions by transitive field-sharing: two methods cluster iff they share a field, transitively. On a deeply-tangled god class one high-fan-out connector field (a shared UI container, a refresh-dispatcher method) bridges otherwise-distinct concerns and collapses them into a single megacluster. On a real ~3,700-line Vaadin view the binding returns 5 clusters but the dominant one is 56 methods / 124 fields — a fine-grained seam a model found by hand (probe-dash-2) is buried inside it. Want: down-weight or cut high-degree bridge fields/methods before partitioning (community detection / modularity rather than transitive closure), plus better name_hint inference than method-prefix. Constructor exclusion already landed and helped (1 cluster → 5); this is the next quality step. The tier and binding are shipped and useful as-is; this is a refinement, not a blocker.
fallback_used: Shipped transitive-closure clustering with constructor exclusion; agent drills into the megacluster or extracts the clean small clusters.
evidence: cohesion analysis on a large view class: top cluster 56 methods/124 fields score 0.97
